title: Montopolis Waste-to-Energy Public Hearing
summary:
*   A special public hearing was convened to discuss a proposed Waste-to-Energy Facility.
*   The meeting took place in the Montopolis neighborhood at Dolores Catholic Church, indicating a focus on local community input.
*   Many residents participated, sharing their perspectives and concerns during the lengthy public hearing.
